title: NETSTREIT Reports First Quarter 2026 Financial and Operating Results
summary: – Net Income of $0.06 and Adjusted Funds from Operations ("AFFO") of $0.34 Per Diluted Share for First Quarter – – Completed $239.0 Million of Gross Investment Activity at 7.5% Blended Cash Yield for First Quarter – – Increases 2026 AFFO Per Share Guidance to a New Range of $1.36 to $1.39 – – Increases 2026 Net Investment Guidance Range to $550 Million to $650 Million – – $314.3 Million of Gross Forward Equity Sales via February Follow-On and ATM in First Quarter – NETSTREIT Corp. (NYSE: NTST) (the “Company”) today announced financial and operating results for the first quarter ended March 31, 2026. “I am pleased to report a strong start to the year with a record amount of net investments completed this quarter. Our disciplined sourcing and underwriting allowed us to capitalize on an attractive acquisitions market while maintaining our strict risk adjusted return targets.
